title: NANOG Assembles into Self-Limiting Aging Micelles That Drive a Sol-Gel Transition and Modulate DNA Dynamics.
authors: Hong-Minh, Amandine; Fosado, Yair Augusto Gutierrez; Guild, Abbie; Mullin, Nicholas; Spagnolo, Laura; Chambers, Ian; Michieletto, Davide
one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟、质谱光度法与冷冻电镜，研究转录因子NANOG形成自限性胶束并调控DNA动态的机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作与物理模拟方法，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Proteins and nucleic acids form non-Newtonian liquids with complex rheological properties that contribute to their function in vivo. Here, we investigate the rheology of the transcription factor NANOG, a key protein to maintain embryonic stem cell pluripotency. We find that, at high concentrations, NANOG forms macroscopic aging gels that are dependent on its intrinsically disordered domain. By combining molecular dynamics simulations, mass photometry, and cryo-EM, we also discover that-in contrast to unbounded condensates formed by other intrinsically disordered proteins-NANOG forms self-limiting micelles with exposed DNA-binding domains. We show that these micelles can stabilize DNA entanglements and, in turn, modulate DNA dynamics. Based on our findings, we conjecture that NANOG may contribute to regulate gene expression by creating local gel-like environments that restrict genome dynamics and that its aging may ingrain mechanical memory in gene regulatory networks.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质和核酸形成具有复杂流变学性质的非牛顿液体，这些性质有助于它们在体内的功能。在此，我们研究了转录因子NANOG的流变学，该蛋白是维持胚胎干细胞多能性的关键蛋白。我们发现，在高浓度下，NANOG形成依赖于其固有无序结构域的宏观老化凝胶。通过结合分子动力学模拟、质谱光度法和冷冻电镜，我们还发现——与其他固有无序蛋白形成的无界凝聚体不同——NANOG形成具有暴露DNA结合域的自限制胶束。我们证明这些胶束能稳定DNA缠结，并进而调节DNA动力学。基于我们的发现，我们推测NANOG可能通过创造限制基因组动力学的局部凝胶样环境来调节基因表达，并且其老化可能在基因调控网络中嵌入机械记忆。
